title: Arquiteto de Soluções em Nuvem e IA
description:
Sobre  a Oportunidade  


Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções em Nuvem para se juntar ao time de transformação do Ad Intelligence, com foco no design e implementação de soluções orientadas por IA para segmentação e classificação de publicidade em TV. Este papel combina responsabilidade arquitetural com execução técnica hands-on, incluindo provisionamento de infraestrutura, configuração de DevOps/MLOps e colaboração próxima com times de engenharia e ciência de dados. Você será responsável pelo design de sistemas de ponta a ponta para ingestão de vídeo, processamento, armazenamento, implantação de modelos e serviços de inteligência de conteúdo, garantindo confiabilidade, segurança, performance e alinhamento com a estratégia de produto.  


Principais Responsabilidades  


Design de Arquitetura de Ponta a Ponta: Definir e ser responsável pela arquitetura em nuvem (Azure, GCP ou similar) para ingestão de vídeo em larga escala, processamento, pipelines de IA e plataformas de inteligência de conteúdo. 


Engenharia de Infraestrutura em Nuvem: Construir e configurar infraestrutura escalável (compute, storage, networking, serviços serverless, containers) utilizando ferramentas de IaC para suportar workloads de vídeo e ML. 


Gestão de DevOps & Pipelines CI/CD: Implementar e manter CI/CD, testes automatizados, observabilidade e pipelines de deploy para dados, ML e serviços backend. 


MLOps & Implantação de Modelos: Colaborar com cientistas de dados para operacionalizar modelos de IA/ML, garantindo eficiência no treinamento, inferência, monitoramento e gestão de ciclo de vida. 


Integração: Definir padrões de integração para pipelines de dados, APIs e serviços nativos de nuvem para permitir escalabilidade global. 


Liderança Técnica: Orientar times de engenharia e ciência de dados sobre melhores práticas e padrões arquiteturais. 


Conformidade & Segurança: Garantir aderência aos princípios de IA Responsável, GDPR e políticas internas de proteção de dados. 


Otimização de Performance & Custos: Avaliar continuamente e otimizar performance do sistema, escalabilidade, confiabilidade e eficiência de custos em nuvem em todos os componentes. 


Engajamento com Stakeholders: Traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos e comunicar decisões arquiteturais de forma clara. 


Requisitos  


O candidato ideal combina profunda expertise técnica em arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (incluindo GenAI) com fortes habilidades de liderança e comunicação. Destaca-se na criação de sistemas escaláveis e seguros e atua bem em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos. 


Experiência Profissional:  


  • Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em funções de arquitetura de soluções em nuvem, preferencialmente em ambientes de mídia, tecnologia ou orientados por IA.  
  • Experiência prática significativa na implantação de sistemas em produção em Azure ou GCP com foco em escalabilidade e confiabilidade.  
  • Experiência com integração, transformação, armazenamento e análise de dados, incluindo workflows de vídeo (ingestão, processamento, transformação e análise).  
  • Experiência comprovada na implementação de pipelines CI/CD, testes automatizados e automação de infraestrutura em produtos reais.  
  • Experiência colaborando com times de ciência de dados para implantação, otimização e monitoramento de modelos de machine learning em produção.  
  • Experiência em design ou operação de sistemas distribuídos de alta performance para workloads de dados ou mídia.  
  • Experiência trabalhando com times de produto, engenharia e analytics para entrega de soluções ponta a ponta.  


Competências Técnicas e Funcionais:  


  • Capacidade de projetar arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e orientadas a vídeo e IA usando Azure, GCP ou similares.  
  • Conhecimento de frameworks arquiteturais, padrões de documentação e modelos de referência para sistemas em larga escala.  
  • Proficiência em Infrastructure as Code (ex: Terraform ou equivalente) para provisionamento e automação de infraestrutura em nuvem.  
  • Forte capacidade de construir e manter pipelines CI/CD, workloads containerizados e processos automatizados de deploy.  
  • Experiência em operacionalização de modelos de ML, monitoramento de modelos e suporte a fluxos de trabalho de ciência de dados (MLOps).  
  • Expertise em design de sistemas robustos, modulares e escaláveis, incluindo microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.  
  • Forte entendimento de segurança de dados, compliance, GDPR e princípios de IA Responsável.  
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas para conectar times técnicos e de negócio.  
  • Entendimento de requisitos da indústria de mídia (video workflows, metadados de conteúdo e compliance) é um diferencial importante.  


Formação e Certificações:  


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Cloud Computing ou área relacionada.  
  • Certificações em nuvem como Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect ou similares são altamente valorizadas. 


Idiomas  


  • Inglês fluente, como requisito obrigatório 
  • Espanhol e Francês fluente é desejável

title: Desenvolvedor Infra-as-Code Multi-Cloud Pleno (Remoto)
description:
Olá!


A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações para provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e manter Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform;
  • Criar playbooks e roles com Ansible para automação de configuração e padronização de ambientes;
  • Desenvolver scripts e soluções para automação operacional utilizando Python, PowerShell e Shell Script;
  • Integrar sistemas e plataformas por meio de APIs REST;
  • Automatizar processos e fluxos em ambientes VMware, com foco em vRealize (vRA / vRO);
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, cloud, segurança e desenvolvimento para garantir ambientes escaláveis, seguros e resilientes;
  • Documentar automações, processos e boas práticas.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida com Terraform;Conhecimento prático em Ansible;
  • Experiência com programação e automação em Python;
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts em PowerShell e Shell Script (Bash);
  • Experiência no consumo e criação de APIs REST;
  • Vivência com ambientes VMware, especialmente vRealize Automation (vRA / vRO);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux e Windows Server.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Colaboração para atuação com múltiplos times (infraestrutura, cloud, segurança e desenvolvimento);
  • Organização e disciplina para documentação de processos e boas práticas;
  • Proatividade para automação e melhoria contínua de ambientes;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas;
  • Autonomia na condução de demandas técnicas;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Visão de dono.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em cloud (Oracle OCI, Azure e AWS);
  • Vivência com práticas de DevOps e Git;
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade;
  • Certificações em cloud (OCI e AWS).

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações para provisionamento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e manter Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) utilizando Terraform;
  • Criar playbooks e roles com Ansible para automação de configuração e padronização de ambientes;
  • Desenvolver scripts e soluções para automação operacional utilizando Python, PowerShell e Shell Script;
  • Integrar sistemas e plataformas por meio de APIs REST;
  • Automatizar processos e fluxos em ambientes VMware, com foco em vRealize (vRA / vRO);
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de infraestrutura, cloud, segurança e desenvolvimento para garantir ambientes escaláveis, seguros e resilientes;
  • Documentar automações, processos e boas práticas.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida com Terraform;Conhecimento prático em Ansible;
  • Experiência com programação e automação em Python;
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts em PowerShell e Shell Script (Bash);
  • Experiência no consumo e criação de APIs REST;
  • Vivência com ambientes VMware, especialmente vRealize Automation (vRA / vRO);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux e Windows Server.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Colaboração para atuação com múltiplos times (infraestrutura, cloud, segurança e desenvolvimento);
  • Organização e disciplina para documentação de processos e boas práticas;
  • Proatividade para automação e melhoria contínua de ambientes;
  • Capacidade analítica para resolução de problemas;
  • Autonomia na condução de demandas técnicas;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Visão de dono.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em cloud (Oracle OCI, Azure e AWS);
  • Vivência com práticas de DevOps e Git;
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade;
  • Certificações em cloud (OCI e AWS).

title: Editor de Matemática
description:
A Saber faz parte do Grupo Cogna Educação, uma das principais organizações educacionais do mundo. Nossas soluções abrangem o ambiente virtual completo de aprendizagem, tutoria especializada, material pedagógico, amplo portfólio de cursos, atendimento ao estudante, BackOffice de pagamento e monitoramento da jornada de alunos.

Nesta vaga você irá atuar no Programa Nacional de Livros Didáticos (PNLD ) com as editoras Ática, Saraiva e Scipione , com a oferta de livros didáticos para mais de 118 mil escolas públicas em todo o país. É uma super oportunidade de mudar a educação no Brasil para melhor! #AquiéCogna


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


• Editar obras das Editoras Ática, Saraiva e Scipione na área de Matemática para o atendimento de editais de venda pública nos diversos segmentos da Educação Básica (Ensino Fundamental I, Ensino Fundamental II e Ensino Médio), verificando a correção, a atualização e a qualidade dos conteúdos da área, a clareza do texto, a adequação das ilustrações e das atividades, bem como reduzindo erros e retrabalhos.

• Dar suporte ao Editor responsável durante toda a produção.

• Elaborar, quando necessário, conteúdos, atividades e seções para o Livro do Estudante, além de orientações didáticas para o Manual do Professor.

• Elaborar ou orientar a elaboração de pautas de imagem, fotografia, cartografia, ilustração, entre outros pedidos.

• Liberar provas de mapas, gráficos e ilustrações, selecionar e aprovar imagens de acordo com a orientação autoral e as regras estabelecidas pelos Editais do PNLD.

• Acompanhar a execução de tarefas feitas por editores freelancers.

• Liberar e acompanhar a liberação de provas com o controle de pendências de iconografia, cartografia, ilustração e textos de terceiros.

• Assegurar o cumprimento do projeto gráfico proposta para a obra, os prazos e a qualidade diferenciada.

• Apoiar integralmente os fechamentos de todos os produtos da área.


Requisitos e qualificações:

• Formação em Licenciatura e/ou Bacharelado em Matemática.

• Profissional atualizado em relação aos conhecimentos de sua área de formação e de atuação;

• Importante ter conhecimento de documentos relacionados ao sistema educacional brasileiro, como BNCC, Editais de programas anteriores, pesquisas recentes nas áreas de Matemática e de educação;

• Conhecimento das ferramentas Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);

• Conhecimento das ferramentas ADOBE e Acrobat Pro;

• Conhecimento de software de edição de Matemática (Mathtype e Equation).\" -

• Capacidade de comunicação clara e objetiva, proatividade, flexibilidade e organização.


Informações adicionais:

Atuação remota.


O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

title: AI Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a senior Project Manager to join our team.

The ideal candidate must have a strong background in project management, specifically in the AI domain.


This role involves overseeing ongoing AI projects , managing client relationships , coordinating with internal teams , and ensuring the successful delivery of projects .

We are looking for individuals who are not only skilled in project management but also enthusiastic about AI and eager to drive new solutions.


While technical expertise is valuable, the primary focus is on project management , product ownership and client satisfaction . This role sits in the Digital Transformation Center and will be close to delivery and research teams.


  • Work model: remote from Brazil;
  • Contract type: contractor / “PJ”;
  • Availability to work according to North American’s Eastern Standard Time (EST).


Job Mission :

  • To manage AI projects, ensuring successful delivery.
  • To encourage a culture of excellence within the team.
  • To advance AI initiatives through cross-functional collaboration.
  • To engage across functions (SMEs, technical teams, leaderships) to guarantee delivery quality.


Key Responsibilities :

  • Project Management: Lead end-to-end project management for AI initiatives, from initiation to successful delivery. Develop project plans, allocate resources, track progress, and ensure timely completion of milestones and deliverables;
  • Client Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring clear communication. Understand client needs, manage expectations, and address concerns promptly to achieve customer satisfaction;
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks and develop mitigation strategies. Proactively address issues that may impact project timelines, scope, or quality, ensuring smooth project execution;
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, and stakeholder communications. Ensure that project status and updates are communicated effectively to both internal teams and clients;
  • Team Leadership: Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a collaborative and results-driven environment. Mentor team members, promote knowledge sharing, and support professional growth;
  • Global Approach: Interact with other regions, partners and ventures following a global approach to ensure consistency and alignment in AI project management across the organization.


Required Experience :

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Project Management, or a related field;
  • Experience in managing projects AI projects from conception to delivery;
  • Familiarity with AI technologies and their applications;
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools;
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate challenges and adapt to changing project requirements;
  • Critical thinking and problem solving to assess client situation and provide actionable outcome-based business/technical advice;
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or other relevant project management certifications (preferred);
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory;
  • Proficiency in Portuguese is desirable.


Required Technical Knowledge :

  • Familiarity with AI concepts, terminology, and industry trends;
  • Understanding of project management methodologies specific to AI projects;
  • Ability to evaluate technical feasibility and make informed project decisions based on technical considerations;
  • Proficiency in using project management software and tools for AI project tracking and management;
  • Knowledge and experience on conducting projects for IT and Service Desk solutions.
  • A background in IT environments, including an understanding of how various IT components and systems operate, is highly beneficial. This knowledge helps in navigating technical aspects, ensuring seamless integration of AI solutions within existing IT infrastructures;
  • Product ownership and ability to work in an agile environment and create user stories;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Strong project management skills.



What's next:

It's best to apply today, because job postings can be taken down and we wouldn't want you to miss this opportunity. To apply, please submit your updated English-written CV.


The preceding job description had been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties and responsibilities required of employees assigned to this job.


Diversity & Inclusion

Here at the Stefanini Group, we value plurality and equity, regardless of race, sexual orientation, disability, age, ancestry, religion, gender, and nationality. We understand and encourage the importance of being you!


About us

We are a Brazilian company with over 35 years of experience in delivering IT services worldwide, ranging from IT outsourcing to application development or IT staffing. We have a direct presence in 41 countries, through our 70 offices located throughout the world. We have managed to become the preferred partner of many small-to-midsize local and regional companies as well. Most of our clients come from industries such as financial services, manufacturing, telecommunications, chemical, services, technology, public sector and utilities.

Stefanini has career opportunities locally and around the world for professionals interested in a vibrant, passionate, team-oriented workplace. If you are a customer-centric person with a \"get it done\" attitude, come over for coffee and a talk on your future career with us! Learn more about us on and join us on LinkedIn , Facebook and Instagram where we regularly post insights from our colleagues.

title: SAP Product Costing
description:
Product Costing Consultant Expert

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long Term Contract


Requirements

Education:

Required: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field

Preferred: Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or MBA

Certifications: CPA, CMA, or other relevant professional accounting certification (preferred)


Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in product costing, cost accounting, or management accounting
  • Extensive hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP CO (Controlling) module with focus on Product Cost Controlling (CO-PC)
  • Proven experience in manufacturing or consumer goods industry with understanding of production processes and cost flows
  • Strong experience with standard costing, actual costing, and variance analysis
  • Demonstrated experience with month-end close processes, inventory valuation, and COGS calculations
  • Track record of leading costing system implementations or significant system enhancements


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA and Material Ledger functionality
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies
  • Experience in global, multi-entity organizations with complex transfer pricing scenarios
  • Consulting experience or Big 4 public accounting background
  • Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, SAP Analytics Cloud)
  • Project management certification (PMP) or demonstrated project leadership experience
  • Experience with cost management in regulated industries
  • Knowledge of automation and RPA applications in finance processes


Technical Knowledge & Skills:

  • Expert knowledge of cost accounting principles and methodologies (absorption costing, activity-based costing, etc.)
  • Deep understanding of manufacturing cost structures including materials, labor, and overhead allocation
  • Proficiency in financial systems and tools (SAP CO-PC, SAP FI, SAP MM integration)
  • Advanced Excel skills including financial modeling, pivot tables, and data analysis
  • Knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS accounting standards related to inventory and cost accounting
  • Financial modeling and analysis capabilities
  • Data analytics and reporting skills
  • System configuration and testing expertise
  • Understanding of internal controls and SOX compliance requirements


Soft Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex costing concepts to non-finance stakeholders at all organizational levels
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen to connect costing insights with broader business objectives
  • Stakeholder management and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams
  • Project management and organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables in a remote environment
  • Change management capabilities to drive adoption of new processes and systems
  • Mentoring and training abilities to develop team capabilities
  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on innovation and efficiency
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, dynamic environments with changing priorities

description:
Venha fazer parte do time da maior rede de joalherias da América Latina! Com mais de 60 anos de história, desenvolvemos um portfólio de marcas – Vivara, Life by Vivara, Vivara Watches, Vivara Fragrances e Vivara Accessories, com foco em joias de ouro, joias de prata, relógios e acessórios.

Aqui você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, diverso, repleto de desafios e com muitas oportunidades de crescimento. Se você se considera uma pessoa criativa, resiliente, gosta de atuar como dona do negócio e é movida por resultados, já tem meio caminho andado.

Vem brilhar com a gente! #VemPraVivara

junto ao nosso time, a atuação da Gerente de Loja tem papel imprescindível na gestão da equipe de vendas, sendo a principal motivadora para desenvolver o máximo potencial da equipe; sempre zelando pela excelência no atendimento, a fim de promover aos nossos clientes a melhor experiência de compra.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Na CWI Software, estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Java para atuar 100% remoto, em contrato CLT, junto a um cliente do segmento financeiro de grande porte, referência no mercado nacional.


Você irá atuar em projetos de alta complexidade, com alto rigor técnico, segurança e escalabilidade, contribuindo diretamente para soluções críticas e estratégicas no setor financeiro.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços back-end em Java 21+ (Spring Boot).
  • Participar ativamente da definição de arquitetura, padrões técnicos e boas práticas.
  • Realizar code reviews e apoiar tecnicamente o time na evolução da qualidade do código.
  • Integrar aplicações com APIs REST e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados, documentação técnica e melhoria contínua.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de UX/UI, backend, arquitetura, produto e negócio.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Java
  • Experiência com Java 21+, utilizando Spring Boot.
  • Boa compreensão de APIs REST, integração entre sistemas e microsserviços.
  • Vivência com testes unitários (Jest, Jasmine, Karma, JUnit, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações, performance e observabilidade.
  • Experiência com CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia no segmento financeiro.
  • Atuação em projetos de larga escala e alto volume de usuários.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência com Git
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma, com visão crítica e foco em qualidade.


Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso dos nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao desenvolvimento e bem-estar das pessoas. Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e com reais oportunidades de crescimento profissional, valorizando a excelência técnica e a troca de conhecimento.


Vem construir soluções de alto impacto com a gente!

title: Gerente de design
description:
A Bas-alto é um estúdio de design full-service que trabalha com startups internacionais, atuando em projetos contínuos com clientes fixos nas áreas de product design, web design e marketing/growth design.

Estamos procurando um(a) Design Manager experiente para trabalhar de perto com o fundador do estúdio em diversos projetos simultâneos. Procuramos alguém confortável em transitar entre diferentes disciplinas, ajudando a conduzir projetos do conceito à execução, mantendo alto nível de qualidade e consistência.


Responsabilidades:

  • Representar o fundador do estúdio em múltiplos projetos ativos
  • Traduzir necessidades, objetivos e problemas em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para delegar à equipe de design
  • Gerenciar projetos, tarefas e entregas em plataformas como Asana, Jira, Clickup e Notion
  • Acompanhar o andamento de projetos de design em produto, web e marketing/growth
  • Ajudar a estruturar fluxos de trabalho, prioridades e cronogramas
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência nas entregas


Importante: Fluência em inglês

Mais de 90% dos projetos do estúdio são internacionais. É necessária fluência em escrita e leitura em inglês para uma comunicação fluida com os stakeholders dos projetos, inclusive em linguagem técnica.


Necessário:

  • Experiência sólida em product design e web design , com entendimento profundo de produtos digitais, interfaces web e mobile, fluxos de usuário, arquitetura de informação, usabilidade e boas práticas de UX e UI
  • Capacidade de compreender como aplicações web e mobile funcionam, incluindo noções de front-end (HTML, CSS e funcionamento geral de interfaces) para facilitar a comunicação com equipes de engenharia
  • Experiência sólida em branding e design gráfico , com domínio de composição, tipografia, hierarquia visual e refinamento estético nas entregas
  • Domínio avançado de Figma , incluindo Auto Layout, componentes, variáveis, organização de arquivos e construção de design systems
  • Inglês fluente (escrita e leitura). A maior parte dos clientes e da comunicação do dia a dia é em inglês
  • Extrema organização para manejar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e delegar tarefas com clareza
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e lidar com diferentes demandas ao mesmo tempo
  • Forte atenção a detalhe e qualidade de execução


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência trabalhando com startups ou empresas de tecnologia
  • Experiência com design systems em escala
  • Noções de marketing e growth
  • Experiência como designer gráfico, designer de produto ou webdesigner


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário : a negociar, a partir de R$ 5.000+, conforme a experiência e o nível de senioridade.
  • Modelo de contratação : CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho : 100% remoto, com possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo, sem necessidade de presença física
  • Horário de trabalho flexível

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Full-Time, Remote):


We are a modern organic marketing agency looking for a full-time Graphic Designer to join our team.


Our agency helps businesses grow using data-backed social media marketing, and we need someone who can create high-performing graphics and carousels for our clients’ social media pages and advertising campaigns.


This role is perfect for someone who is creative, detail-oriented, and comfortable using AI tools to design quickly and efficiently.


Responsibilities:


Your work will primarily involve designing visuals that help our clients grow their audience and promote their services.


This includes:


• Social media graphics

• Carousel posts for Instagram / LinkedIn

• Promotional graphics (sales, announcements, highlights)

• Ad creatives for marketing campaigns


Most designs will be based on content that is already performing well online, meaning you will often:


• Analyze high-performing posts from competitors

• Take inspiration from those designs

• Recreate and improve them using our branding and messaging


You will be working in a data-backed environment, meaning designs are created strategically based on what works — not randomly.


Important: AI Skills Required


We expect our designers to be modern designers who are comfortable using AI tools.


You will have access to unlimited AI tools, including tools like:


• Google Nano Banana (Pro & 2)

• AI image generation tools

• AI editing tools


In many cases, AI will allow you to create or modify graphics much faster than traditional design methods.


However, you should still be capable of making manual adjustments and edits when needed.


Most of the time you will combine:


• AI-generated visuals

• Inspiration from existing high-performing content

• Custom design adjustments

• Client branding


Requirements:


We are looking for someone who:


• Has strong graphic design skills

• Is comfortable using AI tools in their workflow

• Can follow branding guidelines

• Pays close attention to detail

• Works efficiently and independently

• Is hardworking and takes pride in their work


We value people who take their work seriously and consistently put in effort.


Work Schedule:

•Full-time

•Monday – Friday

•9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Eastern Standard Timezone)


Compensation:

•$750 per month


Application Requirement (Important)


To apply, you must complete a short design assignment.


Create one data-backed social media graphic or carousel for the brand:


Product Prep


Product Prep teaches automotive finance managers how to sell more cars and warranties.


Your goal is to design a graphic or carousel that would perform well on social media for this audience.


You may:


• Use inspiration from existing posts in the industry

• Use AI tools to help create the design

• Apply your own design skills and creativity


Submit this design along with your application.


We are looking for candidates who clearly take time and effort in their work.


If your submission shows strong effort and skill, there is a very good chance you will be hired.


How to Apply


Please submit:


Your portfolio (if available)


Your completed Product Prep design assignment


A short introduction about yourself


  • We look forward to seeing your work.

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

Time Commitment - 5-6 hours per day


About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Assess outputs for:
  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)
  • Strong understanding of grammar, syntax, and semantics
  • Ability to adopt different voices and points of view
  • Creative thinking
  • Strong attentive to detail
  • Well-honed internet research skills
  • Ability to embrace diverse teams
  • Ability to navigates ambiguity with grace
  • Adaptability to thrive in a dynamic environment, with the agility to adjust to evolving guidelines and requirements

Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

Time Commitment - 5-6 hours per day


About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Assess outputs for:
  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)
  • Strong understanding of grammar, syntax, and semantics
  • Ability to adopt different voices and points of view
  • Creative thinking
  • Strong attentive to detail
  • Well-honed internet research skills
  • Ability to embrace diverse teams
  • Ability to navigates ambiguity with grace
  • Adaptability to thrive in a dynamic environment, with the agility to adjust to evolving guidelines and requirements

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js- Backend)
description:
About Us

HG Insights is the global leader in technology intelligence, delivering actionable AI driven insights through advanced data science and scalable big data solutions. Our platform informs go-to-market decisions, and we influence how businesses spend millions of marketing and sales budgets.

What You’ll Do

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work as part of our Product Engineering teams
  • Architect, design, and implement service-oriented backend systems and APIs
  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs
  • Collaborate on ideas across the team, from concept through production
  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade SaaS applications with large datasets
  • Experience designing or building AI-powered features or systems
  • Experience working with Python
  • Enjoys startup culture where individual contributions are visible, impactful, and valued

title: Entitlement Engineer
description:
Position : Entitlement Engineer

Duration : Long Term Contract

Location : Brazil, Chille, Colombia ,Costa Rica-LATM

Pay Range: $22/hr - $24/hr



Day to Day:

Insight Global is seeking an IAM Engineer with strong SAP GRC Access Control expertise to support identity and access governance across Tenneco / DRiV’s SAP environments. This individual will manage and enhance SAP GRC capabilities across multiple landscapes, ensure access controls meet audit and compliance standards, and partner closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders.


Specific Responsibilities:

  • SAP GRC Administration:
  • Manage, administer, and control SAP GRC Access Control across multiple landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • GRC Configuration & Support:
  • Configure, maintain, and support SAP GRC modules, including ARA, ARM, and EAM
  • Troubleshoot workflow failures and access provisioning issues
  • Workflow & Rules Management:
  • Design, configure, and maintain BRF+ rules and MSMP workflows for access requests and approvals
  • SAP Role Management:
  • Perform SAP role design, build, maintenance, and remediation across SAP systems
  • Support user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role changes in compliance with internal controls
  • SoD & Risk Management:
  • Conduct Segregation of Duties analysis, remediation, and mitigation
  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security





**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks
  • Audit & Compliance Support:
  • Provide access reports, logs, and audit evidence from SAP GRC
  • Partner with security, audit, and compliance teams during reviews and remediation efforts
  • Continuous Improvement:
  • Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and ongoing IAM/GRC process improvements


Qualifications :

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent professional experience
  • 6–7+ years of experience in IAM Engineering roles
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control (implementation and production support required)
  • Experience across multiple GRC landscapes (DEV / QA / PRD)
  • In-depth experience with the following SAP GRC modules:
  • Access Risk Analysis (ARA)
  • Access Request Management (ARM)
  • Emergency Access Management (EAM / Firefighter)
  • Strong knowledge of BRF+ rules design and MSMP workflow configuration
  • Extensive experience in SAP role design, build, remediation, and maintenance
  • Single and composite roles
  • SAP authorization concepts (SU24, roles, profiles)
  • Experience conducting Segregation of Duties (SoD) analysis and remediation
  • Proven experience supporting audits and partnering with compliance teams
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Experience supporting large manufacturing, automotive, or global enterprise environments


Preferred Qualifications:

  • SAP Security and/or SAP GRC certifications
  • Experience in large, global enterprise SAP environments
  • Familiarity with additional SAP platforms and modules
  • ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori Security





**Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

**Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Marketing Content Specialist
description:
Vaga: Content Marketer (Vídeo + Conteúdo Editorial)

Uma operadora de turismo gastronômico está procurando um(a) profissional para atuar como one-person content marketing team , reunindo duas frentes essenciais: edição de vídeo e redação/edição de conteúdo .

Formato de trabalho:

  • Full time
  • Home office

Procuramos alguém com:

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em edição de vídeo
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em redação, edição de artigos e conteúdo editorial
  • Capacidade de tocar a área de conteúdo com autonomia, organização e bom senso de prioridade
  • Olhar criativo e foco em conteúdo que gere interesse, engajamento e conversão

Responsabilidades:

  • Editar vídeos para divulgação da marca e de experiências turísticas
  • Escrever, revisar e editar artigos e outros conteúdos textuais
  • Atuar como responsável principal pela produção de conteúdo da empresa

    • Qualificações

    Habilidades comprovadas em Redação de Conteúdo, Escrita Criativa e Edição , com capacidade de desenvolver materiais de marketing envolventes e voltados para o público-alvo.

    Familiaridade com as ferramentas de IA mais populares e interesse em automatizar tarefas .

    Experiência em Estratégia de Conteúdo, Marketing Digital e Gestão de Redes Sociais , com capacidade de criar e executar campanhas que aumentem o engajamento e o alcance.

    Domínio de Pesquisa e Análise , para compreender o comportamento do público e aprimorar os esforços de marketing em busca de melhores resultados.

    Fortes habilidades de comunicação e organização , com capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos e prazos de forma eficiente.

    Conhecimento ou interesse por gastronomia, experiências culturais ou turismo será considerado um diferencial.


    Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação, Jornalismo ou áreas relacionadas será considerada preferencial.

    Proficiência em português e inglês , tanto na comunicação escrita quanto oral.


    Proficiencia = ingles fluente!

title: SAP Project Manager - Advanced English
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Responsibilities

• Lead the SAP Tax Reform Program across ECC, GTS, Ariba and CRM 7.0.

• Manage roadmap, planning, risks, governance, and communications.

• Coordinate functional and technical teams.

• Ensure alignment with global and local business stakeholders.

• Oversee integrated testing, cutover execution, and hypercare.

• Manage dependencies between fiscal, accounting, and operational areas.


Requirements

• Fluent English (global reporting).

• Strong experience managing large SAP programs.

• Solid knowledge of SAP Brazil Localization and tax processes.

• Experience with major tax transitions, SPED, NF-e/NFS-e/CT-e is a plus.


Key Processes

• Program governance, SAP Activate

• Deep understanding on Risk, Timeline, Cost and Quality Management

• Executive communication and status management



Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Distribuidor independente
description:
Se você é representante comercial ou distribuidor B2B, temos uma oportunidade de parceria.


O VOCA é uma plataforma de gestão de pessoas e performance para empresas com 100+ colaboradores.


Estamos buscando parceiros para representar a solução em suas regiões com:

* Venda consultiva para RH e diretoria

* Comissões recorrentes mensais enquanto durar o contrato do cliente

* Clientes com permanência média superior a 24 meses

* Ticket recorrente e expansão de conta

* Produto estratégico (não commodity)

* Forte potencial de crescimento de carteira


Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como distribuidor independente no VOCA, desempenhando um papel crucial na expansão de nossos produtos e serviços. As atividades diárias incluem prospecção de novos clientes, apresentação de produtos, manutenção de relacionamentos com parceiros e suporte ao cliente para garantir uma excelente experiência. Este é um cargo remoto, permitindo flexibilidade geográfica, com regime de contrato.

Qualificações

  • Habilidades de Vendas e Prospecção: Experiência em vendas diretas, negociação e construção de rede de contatos para aumentar as oportunidades de negócios.
  • Gestão e Planejamento: Capacidade de gerenciar prazos, planejar atividades e estabelecer metas para alcançar resultados.
  • Comunicação e Relacionamento: Habilidade em comunicação interpessoal para estabelecer conexões positivas e construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e parceiros.
  • Iniciativa e Autonomia: Ser proativo, organizado e autônomo para gerenciar suas próprias atividades e atingir os objetivos propostos.
  • Conhecimento em marketing digital e fluência em redes sociais serão diferenciais.


Se você já atua no mercado corporativo e quer ampliar seu portfólio com uma solução de alto valor, podemos conversar.


Gentileza enviar e-mail para contato @voca.com.br, com seu portfólio de representação e contatos atualizados para agendamento de entrevista.

title: Senior Mobile Developer – React Native (Remote, Startup Environment)
description:
About EverUp

We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend.

The role

We’re looking for an Senior Mobile Developer to join our startup and help maintain and evolve our mobile e-commerce platform. This is a hands-on technical role where you’ll work on cutting-edge software designed to handle high traffic and transaction volumes .

You should be highly organized , have a strong understanding of mobile UI/UX ergonomics , and be familiar with Agile development principles and best practices.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain our mobile e-commerce application using React Native , ensuring high performance, usability, and adherence to security best practices to safeguard user data and transactions.
  • Optimize performance while implementing secure coding principles to mitigate risks such as data leaks, insecure storage, and injection attacks , while staying updated on the latest mobile security threats and OWASP MAS guidelines.
  • Possess a strong understanding of React Native while also being able to write native iOS/Android code when needed—especially for complex integrations requiring low-level platform access .
  • Design and refine user interfaces based on usability best practices , ensuring a seamless and effective user experience .
  • Implement accessibility standards, responsive layouts, and intuitive navigation to make the mobile app highly engaging and user-friendly .
  • Collaborate with the team to design and implement new features and improvements , with a focus on security, scalability, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Work with Git version control.

What We’re Looking For

✅ 7+ years of relevant development experience

✅ 3+ years of React Native (including iOS and/or Android native development)

✅ Strong software engineering background

✅ Experience with Git version control

✅ Self-motivated and able to work independently

Why Join Us?

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere
  • Startup environment: Fast-paced and impactful
  • Innovative tech: Work with high-traffic systems
  • Growth opportunities: Shape the future of our mobile platform

If you’re a self-starter who thrives in a remote, dynamic startup environment , we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now and let’s build something great together!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, PJ model and pay range is 20-30/hr USD.


Must-Have Qualifications (Required)

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and NodeJS backend development (experience with .NET / C# is a plus)
  • Experience building RESTful APIs in a microservices architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (App Service, Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus) — Azure preferred , but equivalent AWS or GCP experience is acceptable
  • Strong front-end development experience with both React and Angular
  • Proficiency in TypeScript , modern JavaScript, and state management (e.g., Redux)
  • Strong understanding and implementation of unit testing and standard development practices
  • Experience with CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS and Material UI
  • Experience working independently and taking ownership in fast-paced environments with frequent context switching
  • Proficiency with development tools such as Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code
  • Required experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar)


Nice-to-Have Qualifications (Preferred)

  • Experience with event-driven architecture and messaging patterns (pub/sub)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker containers for backend services
  • Experience with identity and authentication using Entra ID, Okta , or equivalent (AWS IAM/Cognito, GCP Identity)
  • Experience with Cosmos DB or equivalent NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, Firestore)
  • Experience with logging and observability (Application Insights, OpenTelemetry)
  • Familiarity with modern build tooling (Vite, Webpack)
  • Basic DevOps knowledge , including CI/CD pipeline setup (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • UI/UX or UI design experience or collaboration with design systems
  • Familiarity with PowerShell (PS) scripting
  • Experience using WSL (Ubuntu) environments


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain REST APIs using Python and NodeJS within a microservices architecture
  • Develop responsive and scalable front-end applications using React and Angular , applying modern state management and styling practices
  • Build, deploy, and maintain applications on Azure (App Service, Functions, Container Apps)
  • Support authentication flows using Entra ID and Okta as needed
  • Ensure reliable system integration, performance, and scalability
  • Write, maintain, and execute unit tests
  • Work across multiple tasks and priorities in a rapid-paced development cycle
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across backend, frontend, cloud, and product domains
  • Leverage AI development tools to improve delivery speed and code quality
  • (Optional) Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation

title: Data Analyst
description:
You will be working for a US-based technology company with the leading Software, Web and mobile app development for business in North America helping independent retailers adopt and embrace this new key component of their digital marketing solution. We build and maintain thousands of retailer websites that must run reliably, efficiently, and effectively.

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Analyst to support our data management and analytics initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in data quality, data analysis, and data governance, with hands-on experience using Metaplane for data observability. The ideal candidate will also bring capabilities in data lineage, business glossary management, and data stewardship to ensure data integrity, usability, and compliance across the organization.


The Responsibilities

  • Implement and monitor data quality frameworks and rules using Metaplane
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data anomalies and pipeline issues
  • Define and track data quality metrics and KPIs
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, inconsistencies, and insights
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into data solutions
  • Support reporting and analytics initiatives with accurate and reliable data
  • Document and maintain end-to-end data lineage across systems
  • Ensure traceability of data from source to consumption
  • Support impact analysis for data changes
  • Ensure consistent use of data terms across the organization
  • Partner with business and technical teams to align terminology
  • Act as a data steward for assigned domains
  • Enforce data governance policies, standards, and best practices
  • Support data ownership, and lifecycle management


Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Technical Analyst, Data Analyst, or similar role
  • Hands-on experience with Metaplane (required)
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • Experienced in Data Quality frameworks and tools
  • Strong experience in Data Analysis techniques and tools (SQL, Python, etc.)
  • Experience in Data Lineage concepts and tools
  • Business Glossary and metadata management
  • Data Governance and Data Stewardship practices
  • Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g., GCP, BigQuery)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience querying large datasets
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Strong English communication skills

title: Demmand Planing Specialist
description:
RESPONSIBILITIES - WITH OUR CONSUMER AT THE HEART YOUR KEY

FOCUS WILL BE

• Responsible for sell out and sell in forecast construction and alignment with the distributors (or

marketing and sales team for direct markets) in the markets under your scope.

• You will receive, consolidate and analyse the sales and inventory actuals and forecast from

distributors (or customers for direct markets) and you will lead a Demand Review with your

customers and / or Bacardi commercial teams to align on sell out forecast and sell in plan.

• You will build an S&OP forecast that will be the input for the IBP cycle and you will present

valuable insights for business alignment identifying gaps and opportunities in your markets.

• Responsible for making your sales plan happen, anticipating risks and challenges and serving as

a bridge between the markets under your scope and the rest of Bacardí Supply Chain functions, to

make sure that your demand plan and your customers PO’s are met.

• Responsible for Demand management in Bacardí System. Ensuring that demand is reflected in

the correct codes to the right product origins with anticipation and accuracy. You will collaborate

with plants and innovation teams to ensure that all the innovations are correctly forecasted in the
